From: Maddie Torres <maddie@sierrawellness.com>

Date: Thu, 9 Jul 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sierra Wellness demo — July 12

Hi Camila / Marissa,

Quick note — we just got the updated travel itinerary for our field week and it’s pretty messy: I’ll be hopping between San Francisco, Denver and Chicago from July 11–15 for client visits and a pop-up event. Oliver and I are both on the road for most of that window and switching time zones each day.

We still want the demo, but July 12 at 10am PDT will overlap with prep and site visits. Two options that would work for us:

- Move the live demo to the week of July 19 (we prefer mornings PT / afternoons ET), or
- Send a short recorded walkthrough (20–25 min) of the features and then do a 30-min live Q&A later the same week — easier for our travel days.

If you can send the recording, Oliver can share it with a couple teammates who won’t be on the live call. Let me know what you recommend and we’ll lock a time.

Thanks — Maddie
Senior Program Manager, Sierra Wellness
[mobile: 415-555-0113]

Hi Maddie — thanks for the heads up and sorry about the travel scramble. We can do either approach; coupling a short recorded walkthrough with a flexible live Q&A usually gives the best coverage for teams on the road.

Proposed plan: 
- I’ll record a focused 20-minute demo covering the Tailored Inference workflow + deployment options and share the MP4 by Friday.
- We’ll schedule a 30-minute live Q&A on Mon, July 20 or Tue, July 21 to accommodate East-coast afternoons. Options I can open: 2:00pm PT / 5:00pm ET or 10:00am PT / 1:00pm ET.

If either time works for you and Oliver, I’ll send a calendar invite and include a short agenda and the agenda PDF. If you prefer the fully live demo instead, I can move our slot to Mon, July 19 at 11:00am PT.

Attachments: [Attachment: demo-agenda.pdf (pdf)]
Links: https://calendly.com/redwood/camila-demo-30

Quick note for Marissa — we’ll want to include a brief note about cost-per-token and the Dedicated vs Hosted latency guarantees in the Q&A (two bullets max).

—Camila
